Late night, city’s breathing slow
I’m walking through these thoughts alone

Even silence calls you back again

(The light rising in the dark)
It’s always you, it’s always you

You’re right here in my heart
Even when we’re miles apart
Every beat is calling your name
I don’t need to be strong
When you’re holding me close
You make me feel enough, just the way I am

Right here in my heart
Neowa hamkke ttwineun sigan
(Time that beats with you)
If love is a feeling I can’t deny
Then I know, I know
You’re right here in my heart

[Verse 2]

Soft piano, midnight rain
Every note sounds just like pain
But it fades when I think of you
Like the sky turning back to blue

Seotun mareun mot haedo
(Even if I can’t say it well)
Neoneun imi algo isseo
(You already know)
Maeil bam nareul anajun
(You hold me every night)
That quiet love feels true

[Pre-Chorus]

Maybe love was always here
I was just too scared to feel
Ne sonkkeute daheul ttae
(When I reach your fingertips)
I finally breathe again

[Chorus]

You’re right here in my heart
Even when the world falls apart
Every tear knows where to go
I don’t need perfect words
Just your honest touch
You make me feel enough, more than enough

Right here in my heart
Neoro gadeuk chan nae haru
(My days filled with you)
If love is something meant to stay
Then I know, I know
You’re right here in my heart

[Bridge]

If tomorrow feels unsure
I’ll still choose you, that’s for sure
Sarangiran geon
(Love is)
Finding home in someone’s eyes

Hoo—
Just stay like this with me
Just stay…

[Final Chorus]

You’re right here in my heart
No more running in the dark
Every scar feels softer now
I don’t need to be brave
When you say my name
You make me feel alive, you show me how

Right here in my heart
Neowa na, kkeutkkaji
(You and me, till the end)
If this is love, I won’t let go
Cause I know, I know
You’re right here in my heart

[Outro]

Still beating…
Right here
In my heart 💗

Pop!

Guess your face is my favorite season

Already my heart is warning

Hope today our stars align
Geu sungan neol bomyeon
(When I see you that moment)
Everything goes “shine-shine!”

(My heart jumps up)

(What is this feeling?)

Neol bomyeon maeumi pop!
(When I see you my heart pops!)
Sugar-sweet feelings don’t stop
Baby you make my whole day hot
Pop! My love!
Dugeun dugeun nonstop
Every time you say my name
I go la-la-la—insane!
Pop! My love! 💖

[Verse 2]

Walking slow so I see you more
Laughing loud like never before
Ne moksori dasi 울려
(Your voice rings again)
My heart skips—oh no, 어떡해?

Little things you always do
Make me fall before I knew
Hoksi neodo
(Do you maybe?)
Feel this way a little too?

[Pre-Chorus]

Salmyeosi useum
(A sneaky smile)
Nan tto 들켰나 봐
(I think I got caught again)
Gamchul su eopseo
(Can’t hide it now)
My love is way too loud!

[Chorus]

Pop! My love!
Neol bomyeon maeumi pop!
Candy-like emotions drop
Baby you hit me like bubble pop
Pop! My love!
Dugeun dugeun nonstop
Neowa hamkke라면 okay
(With you, everything’s okay)
Everyday feels like holiday!
Pop! My love!

Hoo— breathe it in
It’s just love, let it win
Oneulman큼은 솔직해
(Today I’ll be honest)
I like you—yeah, it’s true!

[Final Chorus]

Pop! My love!
Neoro 가득 찬 nae 하루
(My day filled with you)
Every beat goes boom-boom-boom
Baby I’m totally into you
Pop! My love!
Tteolligo useum nal ttae
(When I tremble and smile)
Hold my hand, don’t let it go
Love goes pop—and I just know!
Pop! My love!

[Outro]

Pop-pop, my love
Dugeun dugeun, don’t stop
If this is love…
Then I want it nonstop 💕

title: Only My Love
tags: Female Vocal | English + Korean
prompt:
[Intro]

Neoreul bomyeon
My heart wakes up again
Yeah—this is love

[Verse 1]

In a crowded room, my eyes find you
Like the stars know exactly what to do
Joha, geunyang nega joa
(I like you, just because it’s you)
Even silence feels warm with you around

Every little moment feels so true
When I’m walking side by side with you
Pyeonanhage ne pume
(Comfortably in your arms)
Feels like where I belong

[Pre-Chorus]

Eotteon nal-eun himdeureodo
(Even on hard days)
Ne moksori han beon-imyeon
(Just hearing your voice once)
Maeumi nolla
(My heart feels surprised)
Oh baby, don’t you know?

[Chorus]

This is love, only my love
Neoreul hyanghae ganeun maeum
(My heart that runs toward you)
When you smile, the whole world slows
Baby, you’re my miracle
This is love, only my love
Ne gyeote isseul ttae nan strong
(When I’m by your side, I’m strong)
Nothing else I’m dreaming of
You’re the reason I believe in love

[Verse 2]

Holding hands, no need to rush
Every second is more than enough
Mollae seumyeodeun ne sarang
(Your love quietly seeped in)
Now it’s part of who I am

When the night feels a little too long
You’re the light that pulls me on
Eodum soge bichin
(The light shining in the dark)
Is always you

[Pre-Chorus]

Gakkeum bureoun sesang-eseodo
(Even in a world that feels cold sometimes)
Neoye onniga
(The warmth from you)
Nareul gamssajwo
(Holds me close)
I’m not afraid anymore

[Chorus]

This is love, only my love
Neoreul hyanghae ganeun maeum
When you smile, the whole world slows
Baby, you’re my miracle
This is love, only my love
Ne gyeote isseul ttae nan strong
Nothing else I’m dreaming of
You’re the reason I believe in love

[Bridge]

Sarangiran mal bureugi jeone
(Before I even say the word love)
Neoneun imi naege dap
(You were already the answer to me)
If tomorrow feels unsure
I’ll still choose you for sure

[Final Chorus]

This is love, only my love
Modeun nal-e nega iteo
(You’re in all of my days)
Even when the world lets go
Baby, I’ll hold you close
This is love, only my love
Neowa na, just us two
Forever isn’t far at all
As long as I’m with you

[Outro]

Only my love
Neoreul saranghae
(I love you)
Just like this… always 💖

The little plans I guarded like a flame.

We missed the last bus laughing in the cold,
Split one small umbrella, shoulder to shoulder.

I didn’t see your hands already letting go.

Tell me, was I only useful
When the nights were hard to bear?

And decide I wasn’t there?

[Chorus: both]
How could you turn the trust we made
Into a blade behind my back?
I gave you every guarded truth;
You gave the world what I held back.
I miss the friend I thought I knew,
I hate the wound you left me through.
The past is still a photograph—
But I can’t live inside it now.

[Verse 3: male]
I kept your seat beside me out of habit,
Kept making room for words that wouldn’t come.
Now every answer sounds like an excuse,
And every quiet feels like what you’ve done.

I remember your old coat across my shoulders,
The paper crowns we made from takeout menus.

I won’t call the good years false;
I won’t let them make this right.
Male: Look me in the eye and tell me
You knew what you would break that night.

[Chorus: both]
How could you turn the trust we made
Into a blade behind my back?
I gave you every guarded truth;
You gave the world what I held back.
I miss the friend I thought I knew,
I hate the wound you left me through.
The past is still a photograph—
But I can’t live inside it now.

[Bridge: drums pull back, orchestral rise]
Male: I asked the empty room what I had missed,
Asked every memory to testify.
Female: We were young enough to swear forever;
That doesn’t make the promise a lie.
Both: Veritas manet—truth remains.
I name the hurt; I set it down.

You turned the trust we made to ash,
But you don’t get to keep my name.
I gave you every guarded truth;
I won’t be bound to your shame.
I miss the friend I thought I knew,
I face the wound and make it through.
The past is still a photograph—
I’ll close the drawer and walk away.

[Outro: piano and warm pipe organ, quiet female vocal]
The key can rest beside the letter;
The road is mine to choose.
Vale, amice—farewell, my friend.
I let you go; I keep the truth.
